item.title: Pull request #3076 created
item.description:
2935A: Default function options in the static context

Addresses part of issue 2935 by allowing defaults for function options to be taken from the static context.

Currently defined for XSLT only, but if favourably received I will add syntax for xquery, probably along the lines

declare default options fn:doc {'dtd-validation': true()}

A difficulty is that XQuery has no equivalent to XSLT's static expressions.
